notes: Page states parent as Carrier Corporation, part of UTC Climate, Controls & Security, a subsidiary of United Technologies Corp. Page lists sister or similar brands AquaSnap, Aquazone, BDP, Bryant, Carrier, Payne, Weathermaster, but no shared-system claim is made here: the style below is written from Aquazone's own page text, not inherited. Shape matches Bryant style-1 in positions and meaning, but that cross-brand identity is not used as the basis for this file.

styles.era: 10-character format, week-year in first four digits
styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = week, 3-4 = year (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example 4006A17330.
